title: Amit Industries
text:
# Amit Industries

Amit Industries is a Building Materials company. Amit Industries employs 1 person, founded in 2009. Headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

## About

Amit Industries started in 2009 is a leading provider of aluminium and fabrications works in India. We have been trusted by most of architects in India which include Nitin Nishar, Shivji Gala, Noopur Doshi, Shaukat Mukhi and many more. We are the one stop source provider for all the needs in aluminium and fabrication works.

Amit Industries has a long back story. It is been started in 1985 by Shri Rajendraprasad Vishwakarma (currently Managing Director of Amit Industries) as Nisha Aluminium & Fabrications, which later in 2009 has been reformed as Amit Industries. For more than 32 years in the industry we have been striving hard to provide the best of the solutions and quality products to our partner clients.

Amit Industries provides all new latest featured aluminium sliding windows and doors along with the combination of aluminium works with fabrication. A variety of fabrication works which include sliding grills, polycarbonate roofing, shutter doors, tensile membranes, grilling, fencing and many more. We have a highly trained team along with the best of machinery and strong supply chain management system which enables us to deliver the products faster & efficiently to our clients.
